text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0833 CDT.

CANOLA - Steady to C$0.50 higher on firmer CBOT soycomplex calls and overdone sentiments after Tuesday and Wednesday's fund selling. Technical support was seen in the July at C$417.50. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -4.21 Wednesday from -7.05 Tuesday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3846 versus the U.S. dollar and fell to 83.47 Japanese yen and rose to 1.2194 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up in the July with support seen from allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on firmer CBOT corn calls with technical support seen in the July at C$136.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn, wheat and WCE barley calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
